To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of a payment mechanism that requires the consumer to rehearse the amount paid and the immediacy of payment both enhance the impact of past expenses on purchase intentions.

the use of payment mechanisms that facilitate the recall of past payments (rehearsals) and that deplete consumers’ budgets immediately (immediacy) increase the effects of past expenses on consumers’ future spending.
the effects of past expenses on future spending behavior depend on the use of different types of payment mechanisms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of payment mechanisms in influencing consumer spending behavior.
the role of the payment mechanism as a moderator of past payment effects on future spending behavior.
the effects of different payment mechanisms on spending behavior.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the payment mechanism influences the relationship between past payments and spending behavior by affecting the rehearsal and immediacy of payments.
the use of payment mechanism that requires the consumer to rehearse the amount spent and to pay immediately will lead to lower spending behavior in the future.
payment mechanism is an important factor in determining the effects of past expenses on future consumption behavior.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the use of a payment mechanism that requires the consumer to record the payment (e.g., credit card) and that depletes the consumer’s wealth immediately (e.g., cash) is likely to be more effective in reducing purchase intentions than the use of a less aversive mechanism that does not require the consumer to rehearse the payment and that allows for delayed wealth depletion.
consumers’ spending behavior depends on the type of payment mechanism that is used.
payment mechanism can influence consumers’ spending behavior.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of a payment mechanism that facilitates the rehearsal and immediacy of payments can be an effective way for retailers to increase the effectiveness of loyalty programs.
payment mechanisms can be used as an effective means of reducing spending, even if the amount paid is not large.
payment mechanisms can be used to manipulate consumers’ spending behavior by changing the accuracy of past expense recall and by influencing the immediacy with which the payment is experienced.
